title: Feature
description: A single entry in the KeepMees feature bank (docs/strategy/feature-bank.md)

id.description: Short kebab-case feature identifier (e.g. normalized-memory, product-catalog)

package.description: Package that delivered or will deliver this feature (e.g. Package 1, Package 3)

commit.description: Commit hash where this feature was delivered

module.description: src/ module path that implements this feature

deferralReason.description: Why this feature is deferred (if status is deferred)

gate.description: What must happen before this feature can be activated (if status is gated)
